ai-technology.quote: Some early evidence that Google AI Overviews may be doing to Wikipedia the same thing that coding agents did to StackExchange... papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers....

I think the release of GLM-5.3, a very good open weights models with considerable offensive cyber capability, is worth noticing. Open weights models have effectively no guardrails, and they only provide minimal risk testing (though what they do test is eye opening, as you can see in the image).

BlueSky can be a really unpleasant and anxiety-producing place to post about AI, but now that I have been on so many block lists (I guess just because all AI people get blocked) it is better. The issue is that it is now a niche audience of an already niche audience. I think of it like a small forum
